Name: Sea Breeze Cellar
Author: collingbe
Description:
[size=3]you can change the wallpaper/floor in the tropical room, the kitchen is also functional (fridge is not).[/size]



[b]Note: [/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]should be safe to install mid playthrough, but to be safe please pick up all items in your cellar before installing this mod. [color=#ffff00][s]R[/s][/color][/size][size=4][s][color=#ffff00]ecieved report that installing mid-playthrough might lead to outdoor map recolor not applying to the cellar. for now the only fix is to open a new save. [/color] has nothing to do with save files, being fixed. [/s] fixed[/size]
[*][size=3]im using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url] to place bed in the tropical room. This is 100% optional, but if you wish to place a bed there, all you need to do is install this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]for now this mod is 1.6 version only (due to the limitations on 1.5)[/size]
[*][size=3]if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13752]Sea Breeze Farmhouse[/url] installed, exiting the cellar will correctly warp you to the cellar entrance in your farmhouse.[/size]﻿
[/list]

[list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13893]Casual Furniture Set[/url] by katestardew﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture[/url] by Atlasphere
[*]various furnitures by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7/about-me?gameId=1303]orangeblossom[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]

热带雨林房间的壁纸，地板可换，厨房也可以用（冰箱不能用）
[size=3]
[b]注意：[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]此mod应该不需要开新档安装，但是安全起见最好先把地窖里的东西捡起来，再安装此mod。  [/size][size=4][color=#ffff00][s]不开新档好像会导致地图美化在地窖里不显示，目前除了开新档无解。[/s][/color][s]与存档无关，正在修复 [/s] 已修复[/size]
[*][size=3]如果要在热带雨林房间放床，需要安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url]。[/size]
[*][size=3]目前此mod只能1.6版本用.[/size]
[*][size=3]同时使用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13752]Sea Breeze Farmhouse[/url]的话，可以修复离开地窖时传送错位的问题。[/size]
[/list][size=3]
